traits.name: Firefly Form
traits.text: Drifts into town as a glowing insect, slipping through shutters past every guard.

traits.name: Palm-Oil Thirst
traits.text: Drinks oil stores and coconut water; houses it visits fall sick in the following days.

actions.name: Fever Sting
actions.text: Melee: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing. Plus 3 (1d6) poison; the target may catch a lingering sickness.

actions.name: Take a Shape
actions.text: Becomes a stooped human to walk the market unnoticed.

rt.town: seeds sickness house to house; caught by its glow at night

traits.name: Monkey-Faced Bat
traits.text: A giant bat with a flat ape face and a cry that sounds like its name. It lives behind waterfalls.

traits.name: Fish-Pond Raider
traits.text: Swoops on fish ponds and drying racks; fishing output drops while it nests nearby.

rt.town: raids fish ponds and drying racks

traits.name: Hand on Its Tail
traits.text: A sleek water-dog whose tail ends in a human hand that grabs swimmers and fishermen from boats.

traits.name: Weeping Lure
traits.text: Cries like a baby at the waterside to draw people to the edge.

actions.name: Tail Hand
actions.text: Melee: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning. The target is grappled and pulled under.

rt.town: drowns fishermen at the lake shore

traits.name: Coin Hoarder
traits.text: Steals shiny things; its nest is a small treasure worth a bounty.

actions.name: Cinder Cough
actions.text: A 15-foot cone of hot ash: 10 (3d6) fire damage, Dexterity save for half. Recharges after a short while.

traits.name: Born of Fire
traits.text: Rises from a building burned with people inside. Haunts that district until laid to rest.

actions.name: Choking Touch
actions.text: Melee: 18 (4d6 + 4) necrotic damage and the target is poisoned until its next turn.

rt.town: spawns after a fire kills townsfolk

traits.name: Soul's Wage
traits.text: Fights for any side that pays in souls, or in the oaths of heroes.

traits.name: Outbid
traits.text: Changes sides mid-war if the other side pays more.

rt.town: sells its blade to whoever pays the town's enemies most

traits.name: Kindly Neighbor
traits.text: By day a pleasant townsperson who keeps a stall or a seat on the council. By night a long-tongued predator that targets the sick and the newborn.

traits.name: Upside-Down Reflection
traits.text: Its reflection in a person's eye appears inverted; a sharp-eyed healer can expose it.

actions.name: Proboscis Tongue
actions.text: Melee: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing. The aswang regains hit points equal to half the damage.

actions.name: Become the Beast
actions.text: Turns into a black dog, pig or great bird to flee or hunt.

rt.town: hides among townsfolk; deaths rise at the infirmary until it is unmasked

traits.name: The Truth That Cracks
traits.text: Mutters a secret that cracks the minds of those who hear it.

traits.name: Scholar's Ghost
traits.text: Haunts the place it learned too much.

traits.name: Still Holding the Colours
traits.text: While its banner stands, the dead around it fight on.

traits.name: Rally the Dead
traits.text: Calls the fallen of an old battle back to their ranks.

traits.name: Lord of the Steam
traits.text: Lives in the bathhouse. Every few bathers it expects the place left to itself, or it gets rough.

traits.name: Good Omen, Bad Temper
traits.text: A content bannik makes bathhouse visits restore heroes faster; an insulted one scalds them.

actions.name: Scalding Ladle
actions.text: Melee: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire. The target is pushed out of the bathhouse.

actions.name: Steam Shroud
actions.text: Fills the bathhouse with blinding steam; anyone inside fights at a disadvantage until it clears.

rt.town: haunts bathhouses; rest bonus if respected, injuries if not

traits.name: Fair Duel
traits.text: Challenges the strongest hero to single combat; others who interfere break the bargain and are cursed.

traits.name: Payment in Kind
traits.text: If it wins, it takes a year from a hero instead of their life.

actions.name: Pledge
actions.text: The Knight names a target; it deals extra damage to that hero and no one else.

rt.town: demands a duel at the town gate

traits.name: Cages for Sale
traits.text: Sells captive monsters to rich towns and worse buyers.

traits.name: Let Them Loose
traits.text: Opens every cage when cornered.

rt.town: escaped captives roam the roads after its caravans pass

traits.name: Goad
traits.text: Drives a captive beast into a fight ahead of the handlers.

traits.name: Whip-Trained
traits.text: Beasts it has broken obey only it.

traits.name: Fear Sap
traits.text: Feeds on bad dreams; the house above it sleeps badly and grows unhappy.

traits.name: Under the Floor
traits.text: Lives between the boards where no broom reaches.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing. The target is frightened until the end of its next turn.

rt.town: nests under houses and spoils their sleep

traits.name: Iron Toll
traits.text: Each strike rings like a bell; every hero within earshot is deafened.

traits.name: Foundry Born
traits.text: Built by a smiths' guild that lost control of it.

actions.name: Peal
actions.text: Each creature within 20 feet takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage, Constitution save for half.

rt.town: a guild project gone wrong

traits.name: Saucer-Red Eye
traits.text: A huge black hound with one burning eye that walks the coast road at night. Townsfolk who meet its gaze expect a death in the family, and mood drops across the district.

traits.name: Storm Visitor
traits.text: Comes with thunderstorms, bursting through church or hall doors and leaving scorch marks on the wood.

actions.name: Omen Howl
actions.text: Every townsperson who hears it refuses to work outdoors until dawn.

rt.town: walks the coast road on stormy nights; town-wide mood loss

traits.name: Answer to Grukk
traits.text: If Grukk sacrifices enough captives, the Bloodtusk god walks with his warband for one battle.

traits.name: Red Charge
traits.text: Charges in a straight line through walls and houses alike.

actions.name: War Squeal
actions.text: All Bloodtusk units within a mile heal 20 hit points and stop fearing anything.

traits.name: Ride-By
traits.text: Charges through a line of defenders without stopping, then wheels back for another pass.

traits.name: Mounted
traits.text: If the boar dies, the rider fights on foot as a common raider.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Lance attack and one Boar Tusks attack.

traits.name: Read the Bones
traits.text: Before a raid it chooses the weakest wall; the warband always strikes there.

traits.name: Curse of the Herd
traits.text: Cattle and horses in town panic while it is within a mile.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes two Bone Fetish Lash attacks.

actions.name: Shatter Courage
actions.text: Defenders within 30 feet make a Wisdom save or are frightened and leave their posts.

traits.name: Pitch Pots
traits.text: Its shots set thatched roofs alight; the fire brigade guild must answer or the block burns.

traits.name: Shield Wall
traits.text: Adjacent Ironhides lock shields; arrows from the walls glance off.

traits.name: Veteran of Grukk
traits.text: Keeps raiders in line; while it stands, the warband does not scatter to loot.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.text: Melee: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning. Target is knocked prone.

traits.name: Smoke Signal
traits.text: Lights a signal fire when it spots the town; the warband arrives a day sooner.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: Fights harder next to a wounded ally.

actions.name: Torch
actions.text: Sets a wooden building it stands next to on fire.

traits.name: Battering Log
traits.text: Four orcs on one iron-capped log. Deals triple damage to gates and palisades.

traits.name: Lose a Hand
traits.text: Each quarter of its hit points lost slows it further.

traits.name: Half-Giant Champion
traits.text: Grukk's chosen breaker of walls; raiders cheer and fight harder while it is in sight.

traits.name: Trophy Belt
traits.text: Wears the helmets of fallen town guards; each one taken lowers recruits' morale.

actions.name: Boar Spirit
actions.text: Ranged spell: 14 (4d6) force damage at 120 feet.

actions.name: War Drum
actions.text: Raiders within earshot ignore fear until the drum stops.

traits.name: Pack Leader
traits.text: Arrives with three worgs that hunt heroes who wander off alone.

traits.name: Hunting Horn
traits.text: Calls its pack back when the raid turns sour.

traits.name: Soured Helper
traits.text: A house spirit that was insulted or given a name. Now it spills milk, lames cattle and drives families out of the farmhouse.

traits.name: Never Name It
traits.text: A boggart cannot be bargained with once named; it must be driven off by a hero, not a gift.

actions.name: Ruinous Prank
actions.text: Sabotages one farm plot or workshop; its output that day is lost.

rt.town: a domovoi or brownie gone bad; empties farmhouses

traits.name: Carrier
traits.text: A bitten hero may fall sick; if they rest in town, the sickness can spread to the tavern.

traits.name: Rot Nose
traits.text: Tracks the sick and wounded across the map.

rt.town: runs ahead of plague caravans

traits.name: Living Engine
traits.text: A siege engine built from giant bones, hurling skulls that burst with grave-fire.

traits.name: Slow to Turn
traits.text: Cannot shoot targets within 60 feet.

actions.name: Skull Shot
actions.text: Ranged: 22 (4d10) necrotic at 300 feet. All creatures within 10 feet of the target take half.

traits.name: Ossuary Tower
traits.text: Built from every grave the lich has emptied; the dead pour off its back onto the walls.

traits.name: Siege Breaker
traits.text: Deals quadruple damage to walls and towers.

actions.name: Shed the Dead
actions.text: Releases six Rattlebone Levies at its feet.

traits.name: Useless Horns
traits.text: Its horns curl backward and cannot harm anyone, so it defends itself another way.

traits.name: Scorching Dung
traits.text: When chased it sprays burning dung behind it, setting fields and hay barns alight.

actions.name: Burning Spray
actions.text: A 30-foot line behind it: 10 (3d6) fire and the ground burns. Recharges after a while.

rt.town: stampedes through farms and sets haystacks burning when hunted

traits.name: Assessment
traits.text: Goes door to door collecting taxes on schedule, even in the middle of a raid.

traits.name: Malfunction
traits.text: If struck by lightning it starts collecting from heroes too.

rt.town: built by the treasury; can rebel if damaged

traits.name: Sulphur Fur
traits.text: Stinks of brimstone and smoulders when angry.

traits.name: Rage
traits.text: Hits harder once it is hurt.

traits.name: Two Shapes
traits.text: A sailor on land, a gill-thing at sea.

traits.name: Harbour Spy
traits.text: Signs on with a crew and sells the trade routes to raiders.

rt.town: signs on as a sailor and leaks the trade routes

traits.name: Barnacle Hide
traits.text: Grown over with barnacle and kelp.

traits.name: Tidewalker
traits.text: Comes ashore with the high tide and goes back with the low.

traits.name: Booming at Night
traits.text: A deep bellow from the waterholes carries for miles; settlers lie awake and livestock refuse to drink.

traits.name: Waterhole Keeper
traits.text: It claims a billabong or reed lake. Herds watered there go missing until it is driven off or left alone.

actions.name: Tusked Bite
actions.text: Melee: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing. The target is grappled and dragged under.

actions.name: Terrible Boom
actions.text: Townspeople within earshot are frightened; herds scatter.

rt.town: claims a waterhole; livestock vanish and herds will not drink

traits.name: Follows the Late Walker
traits.text: A black, goat-hooved dog with red eyes that trails people stumbling home from the tavern after midnight.

traits.name: Its White Twin
traits.text: A white cadejo sometimes guards the same walker; if the town keeps faith, the white dog drives the black off.

actions.name: Hypnotic Stare
actions.text: A drunken target freezes in place and forgets the road home.

rt.town: stalks late tavern-goers; tavern hours affect its kills

traits.name: Never Gutters
traits.text: Relights itself unless the ashes are blessed.

traits.name: Wax Fire
traits.text: Spits burning wax.

traits.name: Arrives at Festival Time
traits.text: The carnival comes with the crowds and leaves with some of them.

traits.name: Every Seat Sold
traits.text: Spectators charmed by the show will fight for it.

actions.name: Grand Finale
actions.text: every creature watching takes 18 (4d8) psychic, half on a save.

rt.town: comes at festival time and leaves with some of the crowd

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.text: Every chitterkin knows what the hive knows.

traits.name: Field Diggers
traits.text: Tunnels under fields and eats the seed before it sprouts.

rt.town: tunnels under the fields and eats the seed

traits.name: Egg Chambers
traits.text: Lays a new swarm every few days until she is killed.

traits.name: Hive Lord
traits.text: Every chitterkin within a day's dig comes when she shrieks.

actions.name: Acid Spray
actions.text: 27 (6d8) acid in a 30-foot cone, half on a save.

rt.town: hatches a new swarm every few days until killed

traits.name: Ember Trail
traits.text: Leaves smoldering footprints; a granary or haystack it crosses may catch fire.

traits.name: Reagent
traits.text: Its cooled body yields emberroot ash.

traits.name: Roof Strafer
traits.text: Swoops over town, setting rooftops alight in a straight line.

traits.name: Grows Off-Screen
traits.text: Each month it goes unhunted it gains hit points and its lair grows richer.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Cinder Breath
actions.text: A 30-foot line of fire: 35 (10d6) fire damage, Dexterity save for half. Recharges after a while.

traits.name: Clatter Talk
traits.text: Knocks its shell to call its kin through the rock.

traits.name: Wall Climber
traits.text: Hangs from cave ceilings over the path.

traits.name: Living Mantle
traits.text: Wears a living serpent across the shoulders that bites for it.

traits.name: Shed Skin
traits.text: Once a day slips free of a grapple or a cell, leaving an empty husk behind.

rt.town: joins guilds under false names and buys councillors one by one

traits.name: Plague Wagon
traits.text: A cart of the dead that rolls by itself; every street it crosses risks an outbreak.

traits.name: Spill
traits.text: When destroyed, the bodies inside rise as three zombies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Trampling Wheels attack and one Grasping Dead attack.

rt.town: arrives disguised as a merchant caravan

traits.name: Violet Glow
traits.text: The crystal spines along its back shed a cold violet light; it cannot hide, and it does not try.

traits.name: Many-Legged
traits.text: Twelve jointed legs carry it up cliff faces and across cave ceilings as easily as across the floor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The crystalback makes two Mandible attacks.

actions.name: Mandible
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shard Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: The crystalback rattles its spines and they burst outward. Each creature within 20 feet makes a Dexterity save (DC 15), taking 27 (6d8) Piercing damage on a failure, half on a success.

rt.town: tunnels up under quarries and mines; its shards sell for a fortune

traits.name: Bounty Hunter
traits.text: Reads every bounty board in the marches and takes the best of them before the companies have finished arguing over the pay.

traits.name: Mist Cloak
traits.text: Hard to see in fog, at dusk, or under trees; she always picks the ground.

rt.town: poaches the town's bounties; can be hired or hunted

traits.name: Glowing Fronds
traits.text: Its star-shaped nose glows; anyone who looks straight at it reels, dazed.

traits.name: Tunnel Breacher
traits.text: Comes up through cellar floors inside the walls.

rt.town: tunnels under the walls into cellars

traits.name: Tolling
traits.text: Each toll is heard across the whole town; any citizen who dies within its sound rises as a zombie.

traits.name: Bell Tower
traits.text: Seeks the tallest tower in town and roosts there.

traits.name: Keeper of the House
traits.text: Every home starts with one. Fed a saucer each night, it keeps the hearth lit and the horses calm; neglected, it sours the milk and hides the tools.

traits.name: Moves With the Family
traits.text: When a household relocates without inviting it along, it follows anyway and sulks for a season.

actions.name: Hearth Tantrum
actions.text: Rattles pots and snuffs the fire; the house produces nothing that day and its family loses sleep.

rt.town: household spirit; turns spiteful when a home is neglected or moved

traits.name: Stalactite Guise
traits.text: Looks like stone until it falls.

traits.name: Drop
traits.text: Falls on whoever walks beneath it.

traits.name: Headless Horseman
traits.text: Rides a black horse at night carrying its own glowing head. Where it stops, it calls a single name, and that person dies.

traits.name: Gold Fear
traits.text: Even a single gold coin thrown at it makes it turn away; a stingy treasury pays in lives.

traits.name: No Gate Holds
traits.text: Locked gates and barred doors fly open before it.

actions.name: Call the Name
actions.text: Names one townsperson or hero within sight; unless warded, they fall to 0 hit points.

actions.name: Basin of Blood
actions.text: Splashes blood on watchers; they are marked and frightened until dawn.

rt.town: rides through town at night naming a victim; gold wards it off

traits.name: Evening Hunter
traits.text: Only hunts at dusk; parties returning late meet it on the road.

traits.name: Grows Off-Screen
traits.text: Each season it goes unhunted it grows bolder and nearer to town.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

traits.name: Ravine King
traits.text: Its den blocks the only pass; caravans cannot cross while it lives.

traits.name: Grows Off-Screen
traits.text: Grew from a Dusk Bear the town left alone for years.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.

traits.name: Forest Wakes
traits.text: When the lumber guild clears too much forest, the oldest tree comes for the sawmill.

traits.name: Root Network
traits.text: Knows everything happening in the forest; scouts in its woods are watched.

actions.name: Strangling Roots
actions.text: A 60-foot area becomes difficult terrain and creatures there are restrained, Strength save to escape.

rt.town: answers reckless logging

traits.name: Crown of Embers
traits.text: Every wooden building within a mile smoulders; the fire brigade cannot keep up.

traits.name: Called Down
traits.text: Summoned when a guild burns too many ley crystals in one forge.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Flame Scepter attack and two Sunfall attacks.

actions.name: Firestorm
actions.text: A 40-foot burst within 240 feet: 70 (20d6) fire damage, Dexterity save for half.

rt.town: drawn by reckless enchanting

traits.name: Root Fire
traits.text: Burns underground through roots; trees and wooden houses above it can burst into flame.

traits.name: Reagent Heart
traits.text: Its cooled heart is a fistful of fine emberroot.

rt.town: smolders under the lumber yard

traits.name: Seven Mouths
traits.text: Many mouths sing at once; each round a different hero hears their own name.

traits.name: Echo Rumor
traits.text: A party that hears it brings home a rumor that sours the whole tavern.

actions.name: Discord
actions.text: Two heroes within 30 feet must pass a Wisdom save or attack each other on their next turn.

rt.fog: its song is heard from beyond the mapped edge

traits.name: One of Everything
traits.text: One eye, one arm out of its chest, one leg; it hops at shocking speed and loathes all living things.

traits.name: Hatred of the Living
traits.text: Attacks shepherds, flocks and even trees near its glen; outlying farms abandon grazing nearby.

actions.name: Glaring Eye
actions.text: Its single stare roots a target in fear for a moment.

rt.town: drives shepherds off the high pastures

traits.name: Sick Grove
traits.text: Poisoned the grove to save it from the axes, and now it obeys only rot.

traits.name: Bramble Wall
traits.text: Grows thorns across the road.

actions.name: Thorn Whip
actions.text: Melee: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing. The target is pulled 10 feet closer.

rt.town: turns the forest against the woodcutters

traits.name: Borrowed Miracles
traits.text: Every miracle is a trick, or a fiend's gift paid for in souls.

traits.name: Silver Tongue
traits.text: Draws the faithful away from the town's own temple.

rt.town: draws worshippers away from the temple

traits.name: Blur
traits.text: Too fast to see until it stops.

traits.name: Button Thief
traits.text: Strips stalls of small goods in a heartbeat.

rt.town: strips market stalls of small goods

traits.name: Fog-Born
traits.text: Invisible while in fog or mist; first strike from hiding deals double damage.

rt.fog: preys on parties beyond the mapped edge

traits.name: Source of the Fog
traits.text: All map fog for a day's travel thickens while she lives; killing her clears it.

traits.name: Brood
traits.text: Gray Hollow Hounds and Fog-Stalkers are her children and come when she cries.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: Three times a day, turns a failed save into a success.

actions.name: Tendril Grasp
actions.text: Melee: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning. Target is grappled and dragged 10 feet toward her.

actions.name: Veil
actions.text: Becomes invisible in fog until her next turn.

rt.fog: her lair generates fog of war

traits.name: Siege Behemoth
traits.text: Eats gates whole. Structures take quadruple damage from its bite.

traits.name: Driven
traits.text: Warbands herd it with fire; if its handlers die it may wander off.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.text: Melee: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning. Creatures nearby are knocked prone.

traits.name: Harvest
traits.text: Killing it with fire ruins it; killing it any other way drops a ghostcap for the alchemist.

traits.name: Pale Glow
traits.text: Glows faintly in fog, revealing nearby hidden things.

actions.name: Spore Puff
actions.text: Melee: 4 (1d6 + 1) poison. Hero sees phantoms and attacks at disadvantage for a moment.

traits.name: Last Relic
traits.text: All that is left of a lich: its will, still hunting its phylactery.

traits.name: Soul Hunger
traits.text: Every death nearby feeds it.

actions.name: Howl
actions.text: each creature within 30 feet takes 22 (5d8) psychic, half on a save.

rt.town: a dead lich's will, hunting its phylactery

traits.name: Lure Light
traits.text: A glowing lure on its brow draws night walkers off the road to the water.

traits.name: Faith in the Lure
traits.text: Worships whatever the lure shows; a priest can make the whole tribe see a god.

traits.name: Heard the Deep
traits.text: Something below talks to them; nobody can say what they will do next.

traits.name: Tunnel Traps
traits.text: Every tunnel they dig hides a trap.

rt.town: digs toward the town from below

traits.name: Drawn to Sorrow
traits.text: Hunts townsfolk in low moods and deepens their gloom.

traits.name: Grey Shape
traits.text: Seen only at the edge of sight, in a grey wash of colour.

rt.town: preys on unhappy townsfolk

traits.name: Scent of the Weak
traits.text: Smells fear and hunger on the wind from a day away, and leads the pack to the town that is least ready for it.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.text: When it drops a foe it lopes on to the next one before anyone can close the gap.

actions.name: Laughing Howl
actions.text: The pack answers: every gnoll that hears it moves at once.

rt.town: leads a pack that follows the scent of a weak town; raids where the walls are thin

traits.name: Lich's Mount
traits.text: Carries the Hollow Crown's champions over the walls during a siege.

traits.name: Undying Hoard
traits.text: Its bones are ringed with relic fragments.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.

actions.name: Grave Breath
actions.text: A 60-foot cone of grey vapor: 49 (11d8) necrotic, Constitution save for half. Recharges after a while.

traits.name: Numbing Barbs
traits.text: Jaw-barbs that leave a hero stiff and helpless for a minute.

traits.name: Grave Burrow
traits.text: Digs up through graveyards and drags the dead away.

actions.name: Barbs
actions.text: Melee: 6 (1d6 + 3) poison. The target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

rt.town: digs into the graveyard and drags off the dead

traits.name: Stony Hide
traits.text: Gravel worked into its fur turns aside blades.

traits.name: Honey Raider
traits.text: Smells the town's apiaries from a long way off and comes in autumn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

traits.name: Oathbound Dead
traits.text: Leads the dead in the lich's siege; while it stands, Rattlebone Levies hold their line.

traits.name: Turned to Dust
traits.text: Radiant damage stops it from rising again at dusk.

actions.name: Hold the Line
actions.text: Undead within 30 feet ignore fear and turning until its next turn.

traits.name: Mist Step
traits.text: Vanishes into fog and reappears behind the rear rank.

traits.name: Hollow Howl
traits.text: Its howl is heard in town at night; morale drops while it lives.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing. A Large or smaller target is knocked prone.

traits.name: Lord of the Pass
traits.text: Every yeti on the mountain answers its roar.

traits.name: Avalanche Roar
traits.text: Its roar brings the snow down on the road.

rt.town: closes the high pass with avalanches

traits.name: Well Lurker
traits.text: Lives at the bottom of wells and millponds. Children who lean over the edge vanish; frightened parents stop drawing water.

traits.name: Long Grasping Arms
traits.text: Its thin arms reach far out of the water to drag a victim under.

actions.name: Drowning Grip
actions.text: Melee: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning. The target is grappled and pulled toward the water.

rt.town: infests town wells; water supply and mood drop until cleared

traits.name: Pack Howl
traits.text: Howls bring the rest of the troop.

traits.name: Pale Eyes
traits.text: Sees in total dark.

traits.name: Warlord
traits.text: Raiders who can see Grukk do not flee. If Grukk falls, the warband breaks.

actions.name: Bellow
actions.text: Each defender within 30 feet must pass a Wisdom save or be frightened.

traits.name: Knock and Run
traits.text: Raps on doors at night and vanishes; townsfolk sleep poorly and work slower the next day.

traits.name: Iron-Shy
traits.text: Will not cross a doorstep marked with cold iron.

actions.name: Fade
actions.text: Turns invisible until it moves or attacks.

traits.name: Hedge Blind
traits.text: Unseen while in hedges and treelines until it shoots.

traits.name: Mark the Purse
traits.text: Aims for the caravan master first.

rt.town: ambushes caravans at forest edges

traits.name: Bandit Kingdom
traits.text: Controls every road toll in the region; caravans pay him or burn.

traits.name: Known Face
traits.text: Wanted posters raise his bounty each week he lives.

actions.name: Rally the Road
actions.text: Calls two Toll-Gate Brigands out of the treeline.

rt.town: leader of the road bandits

traits.name: Keeper of the Oath
traits.text: The first of the awakened armours, three times a man's height, who still gives the others their orders in a voice like a bell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The castellan makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

rt.town: commands the hollow sentinels

traits.name: General of the Dead
traits.text: Commands the lich's siege lines and chooses which gate to storm.

traits.name: Second Rising
traits.text: Rises again in a day unless its phylactery shard is found.

actions.name: Advance
actions.text: Up to six undead within 60 feet move their speed toward the walls.

traits.name: Empty Armour
traits.text: Nothing is inside the plate but a green light where the eyes should be. It does not tire, eat or sleep.

traits.name: Old Oath
traits.text: Each was awakened to keep one charge, a gate, a temple or a tomb, and keeps it still. Not all of them count the living as enemies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The sentinel makes two Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

rt.town: stands guard, or stands in the way

traits.name: Sewn Mouths
traits.text: Their mouths are stitched shut with starlight; they make no sound.

traits.name: Envoy's Will
traits.text: Move as one when an envoy from beyond commands them.

traits.name: Ink Eyes
traits.text: Its black eyes read what a hero would rather hide.

traits.name: Hoarded Pages
traits.text: Nests in pages torn from libraries.

rt.town: steals pages from the library

traits.name: Ancient War Engine
traits.text: Woken by the enchanters' guild digging into an old vault. It besieges whatever town is nearest.

traits.name: Ley Heart
traits.text: If the town wins, its core powers the enchanting hall for a generation.

actions.name: Ley Cannon
actions.text: Ranged: 44 (8d10) force at 600 feet. Deals triple damage to structures.

actions.name: Shock Pulse
actions.text: Each creature within 30 feet takes 55 (10d10) lightning damage, Dexterity save for half. Recharges after a while.

traits.name: The Roadside Inn
traits.text: Takes the shape of a lovely innkeeper and opens a rival lodging on the trade road. Guests who stay the night are wrapped in silk; your tavern loses trade until it is exposed.

traits.name: Spider Brood
traits.text: Commands swarms of fire-breathing hatchlings that guard the inn.

actions.name: Silk Cast
actions.text: Ranged: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning at 30 feet. The target is restrained.

actions.name: Charming Welcome
actions.text: A creature that hears her invitation follows her inside.

rt.town: runs a rival roadside inn that steals tavern trade and travelers

traits.name: Gale Trio
traits.text: Always arrives as three on a whirlwind: one knocks the drover down, one cuts, one closes the wound so it barely bleeds.

traits.name: Strikes Unseen
traits.text: Caravans on windy passes report sudden cuts with no attacker in sight.

actions.name: Whirlwind
actions.text: Becomes a gust and moves without provoking reprisals.

rt.town: harries caravan drovers on windy mountain passes

traits.name: Water-Bowl Head
traits.text: Its strength comes from water held in a dish on its crown. Bow to it and, being polite, it bows back and spills its power.

traits.name: Ford Wrestler
traits.text: Challenges anyone crossing its river to wrestle; caravans pay it in cucumbers to cross safely.

actions.name: Wrestling Grip
actions.text: Melee: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning. The target is grappled and dragged toward deep water.

actions.name: Bargain
actions.text: A kappa defeated honorably can be bound by promise to guard a ford or teach bone-setting to the healers.

rt.town: holds river fords; pay in cucumbers or bow to pass

traits.name: One Great Horn
traits.text: A furious single-horned beast that skewers elephants. It charges caravans on sight and overturns wagons.

traits.name: Calmed by Doves
traits.text: Only the cooing of ringdoves quiets it; a dovecote in the caravanserai keeps it peaceful.

traits.name: Precious Horn
traits.text: Its horn tests food for poison, worth a fortune to a council fearing assassins.

actions.name: Wagon-Breaker Charge
actions.text: After running 20 feet, its horn hit knocks the target or wagon prone and doubles damage to vehicles.

rt.town: charges desert caravans; a dovecote keeps it calm

traits.name: Lonely Horse at the Ford
traits.text: Appears beside rivers as a fine saddled horse. Whoever mounts it sticks fast to its hide and is carried into the water.

traits.name: Bridled
traits.text: A hero who slips a bridle over its head gains a tireless mount that hauls a caravan wagon alone.

actions.name: Adhesive Hide
actions.text: A creature touching it is stuck until it makes a strong escape; it then dives.

rt.town: lures caravan drovers at river crossings

traits.name: Night Spinner
traits.text: Spins tangled thread in a weaver's house after dark; by morning the cloth is ruined and the household is exhausted.

traits.name: Behind the Stove
traits.text: Hides in the gap behind ovens and chimneys; only a thorough house-cleaning flushes it out.

actions.name: Pressing Dream
actions.text: Sits on a sleeper's chest; the townsperson wakes frightened and works at half pace the next day.

rt.town: ruins looms and robs sleep in weaver households

traits.name: Bottomless Pool
traits.text: A wingless water dragon living in a spring-fed pool no rope can sound. It crawls out at dusk to take cattle, then horses, then people.

traits.name: Poisoned Pudding
traits.text: Old tales say a village fed it a poisoned pie. An alchemist's guild can try the same with enough ghostcap.

actions.name: Drag Below
actions.text: Pulls a grappled creature into its pool.

rt.town: eats outlying livestock; poison bait is an alchemy quest

traits.name: Snuff Lights
traits.text: Puts out street lamps; thieves follow the dark.

traits.name: Soot Faces
traits.text: Hard to see by night.

rt.town: snuffs street lamps; thieves follow

traits.name: Light Thief
traits.text: Drawn to lamps and torches; snuffs them out, leaving roads dark for whatever follows.

rt.fog: flocks to lit watchtowers on foggy nights

traits.name: Master of the Wood
traits.text: Grows as tall as the trees it stands among or as small as a leaf. Loggers who take too much timber find the forest closing behind them.

traits.name: Bread and Salt
traits.text: A woodcutters' guild that leaves offerings at the forest edge can log freely; one that does not loses men to the woods.

actions.name: Forest Maze
actions.text: Turns the woods around; parties inside wander and cannot leave until it relents.

rt.town: answers reckless logging; offerings keep the lumber camp safe

traits.name: Borrowed Voices
traits.text: Mimics people it has heard. At night it calls outside the walls in a lost child's or sentry's voice until someone opens the gate.

traits.name: Bone-Ridge Jaw
traits.text: Instead of teeth, a single ridge of bone that shears through limbs.

rt.town: calls guards out of the gate with stolen voices

traits.name: Ley Battery
traits.text: Draws from the nearest ley line; enchanting halls nearby work at half speed while it is active.

traits.name: Crystal Salvage
traits.text: Breaks into ley crystals for the enchanters' guild.

traits.name: Runaway Engine
traits.text: An enchanters' war machine that lost its controller; walks a straight line, crushing what lies ahead.

traits.name: Ley Core
traits.text: Destroying it yields a large ley crystal and two relic fragments.

actions.name: Overcharge
actions.text: Each creature within 30 feet takes 33 (6d10) force damage, Dexterity save for half. Recharges after a while.

traits.name: One-Eyed Misfortune
traits.text: A gaunt one-eyed crone who is ill luck itself. Wherever she settles, wells dry, harvests rot, contracts fail and fights break out.

traits.name: Once Touched, Never Free
traits.text: A person she grabs carries her bad luck until she is tricked into letting go; tales say by sneaking out under a sheep's fleece.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Withered Grasp
actions.text: Melee: 19 (3d8 + 6) necrotic. The target is cursed with ill luck: everything goes wrong for it until dawn.

actions.name: Evil Eye
actions.text: Fixes a building in its gaze; that building fails to produce for a week.

actions.name: Spread Misfortune
actions.text: One random calamity strikes the town: a fire, a broken contract, a riot in the tavern.

rt.town: settles in town and drags every economic system into bad luck

traits.name: Coiled Around the Hall
traits.text: A wingless dragon with two forelegs that grows by coiling around a treasure. Left unseen, it eventually wraps a whole hill, then a town hall.

traits.name: Shedding Skins
traits.text: Can only be slain once it is made to shed all its skins; each shed one is a hide worth an armorer's year.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: Melee: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning. The target is grappled and restrained.

actions.name: Venom Spray
actions.text: A 60-foot line: 45 (10d8) poison, Constitution save for half. Recharges after a while.

rt.fog: grows while unseen, coiling around more of the map

traits.name: Cursed Noble
traits.text: A hunting lord who killed a fey stag and now runs on four legs under the moon.

traits.name: Pack Master
traits.text: Every wolf and hound for a day's ride hunts for it.

rt.town: its hunts take shepherds and their flocks

traits.name: Arms Twice Too Long
traits.text: Reaches round corners and up through drains.

traits.name: Gutter-Dweller
traits.text: Waits under the street grates.

rt.town: pulls lone walkers into the gutters

traits.name: Collector
traits.text: Comes to town for any bargain broken; demands a building, a hero or a year's harvest.

traits.name: Ledger of Names
traits.text: Every hero who owes it a debt suffers disadvantage against it.

actions.name: Foreclose
actions.text: A building within sight goes dark: no one may work there until it leaves.

rt.town: arrives when the mayor breaks a fey bargain

traits.name: Lava Wake
traits.text: Leaves a trail of molten rock that burns for days; roads it crosses are closed.

traits.name: Volcano's Child
traits.text: Rises when the mine guild digs too deep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes two Molten Coil attacks and one Crushing Slam attack.

rt.town: stirred up by deep mining

traits.name: Severed Half
traits.text: At night it splits at the waist and flies off on bat wings, leaving its legs standing in a hidden spot. Salt, ash or garlic poured on the legs stops it rejoining, and it dies at dawn.

traits.name: Rooftop Hunter
traits.text: Lands on thatched roofs and reaches down through gaps; houses with tiled roofs are safer.

actions.name: Threadlike Tongue
actions.text: Melee: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing. The target is weakened for an hour.

actions.name: Shriek Away
actions.text: Flies off at full speed without provoking reprisals.

rt.town: its lower half hides near town; find it to end the hunt

traits.name: Cursed Performer
traits.text: A juggler, singer or acrobat who cannot stop the act or take off the mask.

traits.name: Join the Show
traits.text: Townsfolk who laugh too long put on a mask of their own.

traits.name: Lagging Image
traits.text: Its image walks one step behind it; every other blow aimed at it strikes empty air until it is hit once.

traits.name: Kitten Trade
traits.text: Its kittens fetch a fortune in the markets, and now and then one gets loose in town.

rt.town: takes stray livestock and is hard to pin down

traits.name: Fog Bank
traits.text: Rolls fog over a square mile of map; scouting reports from inside it come back blank.

traits.name: Lost Sheep
traits.text: Leads lone heroes in circles; they return a day late, if at all.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes two Crook of Haze attacks.

actions.name: Grey Lure
actions.text: A hero within 60 feet must pass a Wisdom save or walk toward the Shepherd on its turn.

rt.fog: spreads fog across scouted land, un-mapping it

traits.name: Fog Web
traits.text: Spins webs so fine they are invisible in mist; heroes caught stay stuck until freed.

traits.name: Hidden Lair
traits.text: Its den never shows on maps drawn by scouts.

actions.name: Web Line
actions.text: Ranged: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning at 30 feet. Target is restrained.

rt.fog: lurks just beyond the mapped edge

traits.name: Living Fog
traits.text: Its breath becomes fog that never lifts; whole regions of the map stay dark.

traits.name: Vanishing Lair
traits.text: Its lair moves every season; a fresh scouting report is needed to find it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: Three times a day, turns a failed save into a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.

actions.name: Fog Breath
actions.text: A 90-foot cone of freezing mist: 63 (14d8) cold damage, Constitution save for half, and the area is heavily obscured.

actions.name: Wing Gust
actions.text: Heroes within 15 feet are knocked prone and lose sight of their allies.

traits.name: One Who Stops Rivers
traits.text: A huge long-necked beast that lies across river channels and stops the water. Barges cannot pass and river trade dries up.

traits.name: Hater of Hippos
traits.text: Attacks any large animal in its river, including draft oxen hauling barges along the towpath.

actions.name: Dam the River
actions.text: Lies across a river route; that trade road is closed until it moves on.

rt.town: blocks river trade routes

traits.name: Reek
traits.text: Its stench turns the stomach of anyone close.

traits.name: Cave Raider
traits.text: Raids at night from cave mouths.

traits.name: Asks to Be Carried
traits.text: A small lost ghost that begs travelers to bear it to the churchyard. It grows heavier each step, and those who stop are crushed.

traits.name: Laid to Rest
traits.text: Burying its remains in the town graveyard ends it for good, and lifts mood.

actions.name: Clinging Weight
actions.text: Melee: 3 (1d4 + 1) necrotic. The target is slowed while it clings.

rt.fog: found on unmapped roads; quest to bury it in town

traits.name: Chews in the Grave
traits.text: A plague dead buried in haste that gnaws its shroud in the coffin. While it chews, its kin above sicken one by one.

traits.name: Coin in the Mouth
traits.text: Opening the grave and wedging a coin or stone in its jaws stops the spread.

actions.name: Gnawing Bite
actions.text: Melee: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing. The target contracts a wasting sickness.

actions.name: Shadow of the Kin
actions.text: Drains one family member in town each night; deaths cluster in a single household.

rt.town: rises from hasty plague burials; kills its own family first

traits.name: Skinless Rider
traits.text: A flayed horse and rider grown into one body, risen from the sea. Its breath withers crops and sickens every herd it passes.

traits.name: Fear of Fresh Water
traits.text: It will not cross running fresh water; a stream around the fields stops it cold.

traits.name: Summer Banishment
traits.text: It is weak in the warm months and stays in the deep; its raids come in late autumn and spring.

actions.name: Blighting Breath
actions.text: A 30-foot cone: 27 (6d8) necrotic, Constitution save for half. Crops in the area die and livestock fall ill. Recharges after a while.

rt.town: blights harvests and herds on coastal farms out of season

traits.name: Coiled Round the Tomb
traits.text: Guards one tomb and never leaves it.

traits.name: Grave Hex
traits.text: Curses those who rob its tomb.

traits.name: Walking Cemetery
traits.text: Its body is a hill of bones. Each wall section it reaches falls in an hour.

traits.name: Grave Hunger
traits.text: Grows by absorbing the dead of every battle; fights near a town graveyard heal it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes two Bone Fist attacks and one Femur Hurl attack.

actions.name: Femur Hurl
actions.text: Ranged: 31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning at 120 feet. Deals triple damage to structures.

traits.name: Bell of Sickness
traits.text: Each day it lives, a random district rolls for plague.

traits.name: Caravan Master
traits.text: Drives plague caravans along trade roads, each carrying vermin and Corpse Carts.

actions.name: Miasma
actions.text: A 20-foot cloud within 120 feet: 31 (9d6) poison, Constitution save for half, and the poisoned condition on a failure.

rt.town: leads plague caravans to town

traits.name: Carrier
traits.text: Anyone bitten may catch the plague and carry it into a house.

rt.town: arrives with plague caravans

traits.name: False Healer
traits.text: Appears as a holy healer at the height of an outbreak; those it "cures" spread the plague.

traits.name: Relic Body
traits.text: Its body is worshipped by the cult that follows it; destroying the shrine weakens it.

actions.name: Pestilent Miracle
actions.text: Every sick citizen in town worsens; every sick hero within 120 feet takes 22 (4d10) poison damage.

rt.town: appears during plague outbreaks

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: Can occupy a hero's space and fit through shutters and chimneys.

traits.name: Sick Air
traits.text: A house it settles in has a chance to fall ill each day.

actions.name: Bites
actions.text: Melee: 5 (2d4) piercing. The target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

rt.town: drifts in behind plague caravans

traits.name: Snares and Nets
traits.text: Sets snares along every game trail.

traits.name: Rare Hides
traits.text: Takes eggs, cubs and hides of creatures the sanctuary protects.

traits.name: Lady Midday
traits.text: A tall woman in white who walks the grain fields in the noon heat. Workers still reaping then are struck down by sunstroke.

traits.name: Riddle or Ruin
traits.text: Asks a hard question; a laborer who answers well, or keeps talking until the hour passes, is spared.

actions.name: Noon Swelter
actions.text: Every worker in the field is exhausted; farm output halves for the day.

rt.town: walks the fields at harvest noon; farm workers collapse

traits.name: Lament
traits.text: Each night of the siege she sings; townsfolk who hear it refuse to work, and morale sinks.

traits.name: Incorporeal
traits.text: Moves through walls and gates as if they were mist.

actions.name: Wail
actions.text: Every creature within 60 feet takes 45 (10d8) psychic damage and is frightened, Wisdom save for half and no fear.

traits.name: Acid Bore
traits.text: Spits acid at the base of a wall; that section loses a quarter of its strength each hour.

traits.name: Living Shield
traits.text: Raiders hide behind its shell as it advances.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Mandibles attack and one Acid Spit attack.

traits.name: Knotted Tails
traits.text: A hundred rats with their tails knotted into one mind.

traits.name: Plague Court
traits.text: Every rat in the drains carries its word, and its sickness.

rt.town: breeds rats in the drains and sickness in the houses

traits.name: Conscripted Dead
traits.text: Raised by the dozen from old battlefields; marches in ranks and never routs.

traits.name: Holy Ground
traits.text: Crumbles into dust if it enters a consecrated plot.

traits.name: Blood-Dyed Cap
traits.text: A wiry old fey in iron boots who lives in ruined towers and must keep its cap wet with fresh blood or wither.

traits.name: Tower Squatter
traits.text: Moves into abandoned watchtowers; a tower left unmanned for a season may come back with a tenant.

actions.name: Iron-Shod Stomp
actions.text: Charges and tramples a fallen target.

rt.town: occupies unmanned watchtowers and ruined keeps

traits.name: One Grudge
traits.text: Back from the grave for one enemy; nothing else matters to it.

traits.name: Rises Again
traits.text: Unless its grudge is settled, it rises again in a day.

traits.name: Twelve Legs
traits.text: Runs over ice and snow as if it were stone.

traits.name: Freezing Coils
traits.text: Anything it wraps in its coils ices over.

traits.name: Abandoned Workshop
traits.text: Builds in the ruins what the town's foundry would not allow.

traits.name: Animate the Tools
traits.text: The workshop's hammers and saws fight for it.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: A cloud of dead crows; fits into towers and through shutters.

traits.name: Crop Blight
traits.text: Fields it lands on yield half their harvest that season.

actions.name: Pecking Storm
actions.text: Melee: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing. Half damage if the flock is below half hit points.

rt.town: blights farm plots during plague years

traits.name: Whisperer
traits.text: Invisible at will. Each night it spreads a false rumor in a tavern.

rt.town: a cult's spy; hurts mood and council trust

traits.name: Taken in the Night
traits.text: Carries one sleeper off in its sack; only a bounty brings them home.

traits.name: Never Seen Twice
traits.text: Nobody who sees it can say what its face looked like.

actions.name: Sack
actions.text: The target is restrained inside the sack.

rt.town: carries off a townsperson in the night

traits.name: Scorpion Mount
traits.text: Rides a giant scorpion that stings while the rider strikes.

traits.name: Dune Rider
traits.text: Crosses open sand at a gallop and vanishes behind the dunes.

rt.town: raids caravans from the dunes

traits.name: Hanging From the Canopy
traits.text: Sits high in the trees with long legs dangling, iron hooks for feet. Travelers on the forest road are hoisted up and never seen again.

traits.name: Iron Teeth
traits.text: Its teeth are iron; a blacksmith who gets one can forge a fear-proof charm.

actions.name: Iron Foot-Hook
actions.text: Melee: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing. The target is grappled and lifted into the branches.

rt.town: snatches travelers on forest trade roads

traits.name: Swap Places
traits.text: Lies down in a sleeper's bed and takes their place.

traits.name: Strings
traits.text: Moves as if someone above pulls on it.

rt.town: swaps places with a sleeping child

traits.name: One Mark
traits.text: Sent after one target and stops at nothing until it has them.

traits.name: Cage Back
traits.text: Carries its catch home in the cage on its back.

rt.town: comes for one marked person and carries them off

traits.name: Silk Armour
traits.text: Wrapped in hardened spider silk; arrows and blades bite poorly.

traits.name: The Priestess's Child
traits.text: Fights hardest beside the spider-woman who bore it.

traits.name: The Hunt Rides
traits.text: Rides with the cursed lodge's hounds on moonless nights.

traits.name: Horn Call
traits.text: Its horn turns brave men back.

traits.name: Horned Mask
traits.text: Wears the horns and skull-strings of the dead it has bound, and smoke follows it wherever it squats.

traits.name: Memory of the Fallen
traits.text: Where blood was spilled it can call the dead back up: every raid the town suffered leaves it more to wake.

actions.name: Spirit Lash
actions.text: Ranged spell: 18 (4d8) necrotic, and the target is frightened until its next turn.

actions.name: Raise the Fallen
actions.text: Two of the dead nearby rise as zombies under its command.

rt.town: wakes the dead of past raids near where they fell

traits.name: Bargain from Beyond
traits.text: Offers the council knowledge in exchange for a district; refusals bring nightmares.

traits.name: Tidal Mind
traits.text: Heroes who scry it lose a spell slot and see the sky ripple.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes two Dreaming Tendril attacks and one Star Lance attack.

rt.town: treats with the council through dreams

traits.name: Lightning Rod
traits.text: Lightning strikes its nearest tall building each turn: towers, temples and the mayor's hall.

traits.name: Thunderhead
traits.text: Storms over town while it is near; harvests and caravans suffer.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Thunder Fist attack and two Bolt attacks.

traits.name: Stampede
traits.text: Herds of them flatten fences and fields when spooked by thunder.

traits.name: Hides and Horns
traits.text: A hunted bison feeds a tavern for a month.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Gore attack and one Hooves attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text: Melee: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing. If it charged, the target is knocked prone.

rt.town: stampedes through outer farms in storms

traits.name: Count Everything
traits.text: Stops to count coins, carts and paving stones; anything uncounted is out of place.

traits.name: Order Above All
traits.text: Attacks whatever it judges out of place, friend or foe.

rt.town: stops carts at the gate to count their loads

traits.name: Cat-Faced Worm
traits.text: A thick serpent with a cat's head and two stubby forelegs that lies across high passes and screeches at anything that comes close.

traits.name: Pass Blocker
traits.text: While it lairs on a pass, caravans turn back and that trade road earns nothing.

actions.name: Venom Breath
actions.text: A 15-foot cone of poisonous vapor: 21 (6d6) poison, Constitution save for half. Recharges after a while.

rt.town: closes mountain trade passes

traits.name: End of the Campaign
traits.text: The lich whose siege ends the game; the Hollow Crown's legion marches when it wakes.

traits.name: Scattered Phylactery
traits.text: Its life is split among relic fragments hidden in the fog; each one found weakens it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: Three times a day, turns a failed save into a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes three Crown of Cold Fire attacks.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.text: Melee: 25 (4d8 + 7) cold. Target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Raise the Fallen
actions.text: Every dead hero and citizen within 300 feet rises as a Rattlebone Levy.

actions.name: Blot the Map
actions.text: Scrying anywhere in the region shows only darkness for a day.

traits.name: Hunger Below
traits.text: Swallows whole districts from beneath; buildings simply vanish one night.

traits.name: Thousand Mouths
traits.text: Heroes standing next to it are bitten each round without it lifting a finger.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: Three times a day, turns a failed save into a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes two Swallowing Maw attacks and two Lashing Tongue attacks.

actions.name: Swallowing Maw
actions.text: Melee: 41 (5d12 + 9) acid. A Large or smaller target is swallowed.

actions.name: Quake
actions.text: The ground within 120 feet cracks; walls and towers take heavy damage.

traits.name: Hedge Wall
traits.text: Grows a thorn hedge across a road overnight; caravans must cut through or turn back.

traits.name: Bloodmoss Garden
traits.text: Her grove is thick with bloodmoss for any alchemist who dares.

actions.name: Briar Whip
actions.text: Melee: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing. Target is restrained until it breaks free.

actions.name: Grasping Grove
actions.text: Ground within 30 feet becomes difficult terrain for a minute.

rt.town: blocks trade roads with thorns

traits.name: Rot-Wood
traits.text: Twigs and thorns knotted into a shape by a sick grove.

traits.name: Seed Spread
traits.text: Where it falls, brambles spring up.

traits.name: Memory Drain
traits.text: A hero it feeds on forgets the last map they drew; the scouted area fogs over again.

traits.name: Sewer Lair
traits.text: Nests under libraries and the scriveners' hall.

traits.name: Kraken Cult
traits.text: Preaches the deep god and calls its arms up from the harbour.

traits.name: Drowned Choir
traits.text: The drowned dead come ashore when it sings.

rt.town: calls tentacles up from the harbour against ships

traits.name: Path-Twister
traits.text: Tall and horse-headed, it bends trails so travelers walk in circles. Parties returning from its woods report maps that do not match the land.

traits.name: Golden Mane Hairs
traits.text: A hero who rides it and plucks three golden hairs makes it a loyal steed and guide.

actions.name: Lead Astray
actions.text: One party in its woods loses its way and spends an extra day returning.

rt.fog: scrambles scouted trails; parties return late with wrong maps

traits.name: Road Toll
traits.text: Sets up a barricade on a trade road; caravans that pass lose a share of their goods.

traits.name: Paid Off
traits.text: Bribe it and it leaves; do nothing and it gets bolder.

rt.town: taxes caravans on the trade roads

traits.name: Mobile Fort
traits.text: Archers ride its shell; it is a siege tower that walks.

traits.name: Slow Ruin
traits.text: Each hour it rests against a tower, the tower takes heavy damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Shell Ram attack and one Beak attack.

actions.name: Shell Ram
actions.text: Melee: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning. Deals triple damage to structures.

traits.name: Barrel-Bellied Snake
traits.text: A fat, short serpent that bites its own tail and rolls downhill faster than a running man.

traits.name: Tavern Thief
traits.text: Smells strong drink from afar; it slips into cellars and drains the casks. Taverns post bounties that are rarely collected.

actions.name: Roll Away
actions.text: Rolls into a wheel and flees at double speed.

rt.town: drains tavern cellars; elusive bounty that rumors exaggerate

traits.name: Gate Breaker
traits.text: Shoulders into gates and doors for triple damage to structures.

traits.name: Painted Tusks
traits.text: Bloodtusk shamans paint it before battle; it fears nothing while the paint is fresh.

traits.name: Sea Priest
traits.text: A vast black head rising from calm water with pale round eyes, appearing to river barges and fishing fleets on still nights.

traits.name: The Bottomless Barrel
traits.text: It asks for a barrel. Hand it a whole one and it fills it with water to sink the boat; hand it one without a bottom and it leaves.

actions.name: Swamp the Hull
actions.text: One ship or barge fills with water and sinks; a dock it reaches is torn apart.

actions.name: Black Wave
actions.text: A wave 60 feet wide: 33 (6d10) bludgeoning, Strength save for half, and creatures are swept away. Recharges after a while.

rt.town: sinks barges and harbor shipping; a trick barrel turns it away

traits.name: Hand Behind the Council
traits.text: Leads the Velvet Assembly; while hidden, one council vote a month goes the cult's way.

traits.name: Unmasking
traits.text: Exposing the Chancellor turns every Masque and Notary hostile at once.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: Three times a day, turns a failed save into a success.

actions.name: Order to Kneel
actions.text: Up to three heroes within 60 feet make a Wisdom save or fall prone and are charmed until their next turn.

traits.name: Seal of Silence
traits.text: Townsfolk who confessed to it will not testify; investigations into the cult stall.

traits.name: Hidden Chapel
traits.text: Runs services in a cellar under a tavern; finding it requires a rumor or a scry.

actions.name: Dark Absolution
actions.text: Restores 20 hit points to a cultist within 30 feet.

traits.name: Borrowed Face
traits.text: Takes the face of a council member it has replaced; only scrying or a mage's truesight reveals it.

traits.name: Votes Bought
traits.text: While it holds a seat, cult-friendly laws pass more easily.

actions.name: Unnerving Gaze
actions.text: Ranged: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic at 60 feet. Target cannot attack the Masque until its next turn.

traits.name: Forged Decree
traits.text: Once a week it alters a council edict; taxes or laws quietly change until an auditor notices.

traits.name: Seat Warmer
traits.text: Works its way into a council clerk position and reports every vote.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes one Sealing Wax Knife attack and one Binding Clause attack.

actions.name: Binding Clause
actions.text: Ranged: 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic at 60 feet. Target must pass a Wisdom save or be stunned until its next turn.

traits.name: Friendly Face
traits.text: Looks like any townsperson until exposed by a scrying or a guard captain's inquiry.

traits.name: Recruiter
traits.text: Each week it may turn one unhappy citizen into a cultist.

actions.name: Honeyed Word
actions.text: One citizen within earshot drops their opinion of the mayor and the council.

traits.name: Old Man of the Millpond
traits.text: A frog-faced, green-bearded elder who rules a millpond and keeps the drowned as servants.

traits.name: Miller's Debt
traits.text: Every mill on its water owes it a sacrifice each year: a black rooster or a sack of grain. Unpaid, it breaks the dam and floods the lower town.

actions.name: Drowning Grasp
actions.text: Melee: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning. The target is grappled and held underwater.

actions.name: Call the Drowned
actions.text: Two drowned servants rise to fight for it.

actions.name: Burst the Dam
actions.text: Floods the riverside district; the mill stops and buildings there take damage.

rt.town: demands a yearly tithe from the mill or floods the river quarter

traits.name: Siege Beast
traits.text: Deals triple damage to walls and buildings. Warbands drive it ahead of an assault.

traits.name: Ward Eater
traits.text: Gnaws through magical wards and warding stones; spells protecting a wall fail where it digs.

traits.name: Crystal Heart
traits.text: Leaves a lump of wardsalt when destroyed.

actions.name: Salt Pincer
actions.text: Melee: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing. Target cannot regain hit points until its next turn.

traits.name: Silvered Chains
traits.text: Spellcasters it binds cannot cast.

traits.name: Accuser
traits.text: Names a mage, a druid or a warlock as a witch, and the town listens.

rt.town: hounds the town's mages and hedge witches

traits.name: Writ of Inquiry
traits.text: Carries a writ that calls every mage in town to answer for themselves.

traits.name: Burning Court
traits.text: Holds a trial in the square; whoever it convicts burns.

actions.name: Banishing Word
actions.text: a spellcaster within 60 feet loses its next spell.

rt.town: puts the town's mages on trial

traits.name: Withering Gaze
traits.text: Whatever meets its eyes withers: grass, cattle, heroes.

traits.name: Ash Trail
traits.text: Crops die along the road it walks.

rt.town: crops die along the road it walks

traits.name: Garden Raider
traits.text: Comes down from the woods in warrens to strip vegetable plots and herb beds bare overnight.

traits.name: Prized Trophy
traits.text: Its antlered, winged pelt sells well to taverns as a wall mount, making it a cheap first bounty for new hunters.

rt.town: strips herb gardens; cheap tavern-trophy bounty

traits.name: Grub Lantern
traits.text: A glowing grub steers it from inside the chest; when the body falls, the grub leaps to the newly dead.

traits.name: Spreading Rot
traits.text: A hero it bites falls sick on the way home.

rt.town: its grubs leap to the newly dead; sickness spreads

traits.name: Snow-Blind Ambush
traits.text: Waits white on white beside the pass and strikes from the drift.

traits.name: Chilling Stare
traits.text: A traveller who meets its eyes freezes where they stand.

rt.town: takes travellers on the high pass

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.text: Each head acts on its own. Cut one off and it grows back unless the stump is burned at once.

traits.name: Tribute of Maidens and Gold
traits.text: It demands a yearly tribute from every town within flight; a town that refuses is burned in an air siege.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Triple Fire Breath
actions.text: Three 60-foot cones: 49 (14d6) fire each, Dexterity save for half. Thatched roofs ignite. Recharges after a while.

actions.name: Wing Gale
actions.text: Flattens tents, scaffolds and wooden palisades nearby.

rt.town: demands yearly tribute; burns towns from the air
